verdict.rationale: Workers documentation mentions Queues, cron jobs, and durable Workflows (cloudflare-docs-9), which are building blocks that could be used to orchestrate bulk/batch processing across many items, but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of a bulk-operations API, batch endpoint, or example of processing many items in a single call. Missing for 10: dedicated bulk API/CLI feature (e.g., bulk KV writes, batch job examples), first-party guide on batch processing patterns, and independent confirmation of bulk workflows at scale.
